reproducibility.research_question: Can historical Sentinel-2 optical imagery improve Sentinel-1-based urban change detection when contemporaneous Sentinel-2 imagery is unavailable?
reproducibility.pos_weight_rationale: 10 training cities: 126,312 change pixels / 5,146,327 no-change pixels = 40.7, rounded to 41. Applied only during training; evaluation threshold unchanged at 0.5.
reproducibility.modality: Asynchronous multimodal: S1 VV (T1+T2, 2 ch) and historical S2 (T1 only, 13 ch)
reproducibility.optical_t2_handling: S2 T2 never loaded or used; optical encoder receives 13 historical S2 T1 bands only
reproducibility.false_alarm_rate: FAR = FP / (FP + TN): the fraction of unchanged pixels predicted as change.
reproducibility.training_orbit: np.random.choice of ORBITS[city], after seed is set
reproducibility.evaluation_orbit: first orbit listed for each city
reproducibility.checkpoint_selection: highest validation F1 on full validation-city images
reproducibility.test_metric_aggregation: pixel counts pooled across the official test cities, once, after training
reproducibility.city_summary: unweighted mean and sample standard deviation, omitting undefined rates
